t: This is St Michael Paternoster Royal, a church in the City of London. The original, first recorded in the thirteenth century, was destroyed in the Great Fire of 1666. It was rebuilt under Sir Christopher Wren, who was responsible for rebuilding 52 City churches. The Blitz severely damaged it, and it was restored between 1966 and 1968. Among those buried here are two Lord Mayors of London, Sir John Yonge, who died in 1481, and Sir Samuel Pennant, who died in 1750. Andrew King, a Fellow of the Royal Society, is buried here as well.
